commit_scope: Optimize session startup for a human who brings a difficult conversation. Adds scripts/difficult_conversation_arrival.py, a small SessionStart carrier that prints the kernel's difficult-conversation counsel card inside the ~2 KB preview the harness keeps of hook output (the 97 KB arrival stream never reached the model past its first ~2 KB), wires it into the Claude, Codex, and Grok session hooks right after the identity carrier, and lands the edges: CLAUDE.md (How This Body Is Tended), the agent start packet's prompt routing, and the regenerated INDEX files. The BODY is the kernel cell cognition/difficult-conversation-counsel.fk in seeker71/coherence-kernel (PR #586): eleven moves, each naming the cell it lives in, plus the third-party lane predicate (the other stays theirs: reported / inferred, nothing observed) composed with the dialogue covenant; the card's byte length is a band bit. The carrier runs the kernel door when the form/ pin carries the recipe and a built fkwu stands at its root, and mirrors the card until then; it adds this repo's one line (family / partner: the tender-ground files gate first).
evidence_refs: Diagnosis: scripts/arrival.py streams 97,069 bytes at SessionStart (orientation + 53 KB start packet + 37 KB wellness); the harness persists oversized hook output and feeds the model a ~2 KB preview from the top, so only ORIENTATION reached a session and nothing about meeting a person with a hard conversation ever did. carry_thread.py already records the same finding for identity, which is why the counsel gets its own small hook placed right after it.

The body: seeker71/coherence-kernel PR #586 — cognition/difficult-conversation-counsel.fk (eleven moves as data, six body cells checked on disk, five origin-field companions named without a path; dcc-other-held-open? and dcc-reply-lands? composed over dialogue-covenant.fk), band cognition/tests/difficult-conversation-counsel-band.fk -> 1111111111 on a fresh fkwu (ground 42, freshness 31), preflight clean, card 1794 bytes against an 1800-byte window bit, door observe/difficult-conversation-arrival-run.fk, teaching teachings/difficult-conversations.md. The band is fkwu-witnessed: fs_exists / str_find / print_str bind on go, rust, fkwu (pf-arm-mask 11) and not on the TypeScript walker.

Carrier proof: python3 scripts/difficult_conversation_arrival.py prints 1,969 bytes (card 1794 + newline + this repo's tender-ground line) — under the 2,048-byte PREVIEW_WINDOW; api/tests/test_difficult_conversation_arrival.py pins the kernel window (<= 1800 bytes for the mirror), the whole-output window, eleven rows each naming a cell, the kernel door preferred when a built fkwu and the recipe stand (trailing value line stripped), fallback to the mirror on a failed door, no run without the recipe, main() never raising, and the gate line living only in this repo.

Tests: 8 passed under the real api/tests/conftest.py (cd api && python3 -m pytest tests/test_difficult_conversation_arrival.py -q) with one package stubbed outside the repo: pywebpush, whose http-ece wheel does not build in this container; pydantic, sqlalchemy, pynacl, and email-validator installed for the run. CI's API suite (thread-gates.yml) runs only when api/app, form, or deploy/front-door change, so it did not run on this PR; the local conftest run is the witness.

Hooks: .claude/settings.json, .codex/hooks.json, .grok/hooks/hooks.json each gained one SessionStart command right after their identity/greeting carrier; all three re-load as JSON (json.dump round-trip preserved). The Cursor hook is left alone: its sessionStart has no context-injection output field (documented in .cursor/hooks/coherence-session.sh).

Edges in the same commit: CLAUDE.md paragraph under Tender ground (the counsel card, the kernel teaching, the family/partner gate), docs/shared/agent-start-packet.md Prompt Routing row, scripts/INDEX.md + api/tests/INDEX.md + MANIFEST.md regenerated (generate_repo_indexes.py --check clean). make wellness: 2 durable docs edited on this branch, every added line speaks from what IS.

Honest floor: the mirror composts once the form/ gitlink carries the kernel recipe and fkwu host-io runs at SessionStart; until that bump the carrier prints the mirrored card, and a test cross-checking mirror against recipe is the next step after the pin moves.
